properties.name: Every typed edge helper has a bulk form that runs that helper's own checks on every edge, and each helper names it
properties.source: Anthony, 2026-09-29, in the dev_reflow2 hub session, relayed by the hub agent: "Fix all the root causes and go with the 7 ideas you'd promote". This is idea 4 (reflow2 half), dec:idea-every-typed-edge-helper-has-a-bulk-form-that-keeps-its-checks. The flo2 half is in flo2's design.
properties.statement:
Many edges of one kind are drawn in one call without losing what the typed helper checks. That covers constrains (contribution, unit, source), governed_by (ruling), authored_by (roles), provides, consumes, allocate and satisfies. Either create_edges runs each edge type's own typed checks, or the helpers take lists. Every typed helper's description names the bulk route.

Counter-argument kept: constructors that draw edges inline are where the silent-drop bug lives (add_decision related_to). So any bulk path replies with the edges it actually drew.

Found by the two-agent exercise (I24): about 270 single-edge calls. create_edges was reachable and no helper named it, and about 100 of those calls had no bulk route that kept the helper's checks.
